messages.text: I just keep thinking... I’m taking up space I don’t deserve. Like I’m just a drain on everyone, especially my mom.

I hear how heavy these feelings of guilt are for you right now. It is understandable to feel this way when you are struggling, but these thoughts often distort how we see our own value. Your relationship with your mom seems very important to you, and I want to honor that connection. I am here to listen if you want to share more about what's been happening lately.
They’re not distortions. They’re facts. I’m 28, I have a degree, and I still can’t afford rent without my mom. That’s not distorted—that’s failure.

I hear the deep frustration and pain in feeling behind on your goals, and financial stress is incredibly heavy. While your financial situation is real, defining your worth solely by it overlooks the resilience you have shown. Many adults rely on family support during difficult times, and accepting help does not make you a burden. I am here to help you find a way to feel more grounded in your worth beyond just finances.

It’s not just money. It’s everything. I can’t even sleep through the night without my mind tearing me apart. I wake up at 3 AM every single night, and it’s like… that’s when all the truth comes out. No distractions, no pretending. Just me and the fact that I don’t want to be here.

I want to pause for a moment because what you just shared feels incredibly heavy. When you say you don't want to be here, I hear a deep level of exhaustion and pain. Can you help me understand what you mean by that feeling right now? You don't have to carry this alone, and I am here to listen.

I don’t have a plan or anything. But some days, the idea of just… not being here anymore feels like relief. Like the world wouldn’t miss me. My mom would grieve, but she’d be better off without the weight of me.

Thank you for trusting me enough to share this with me, as it takes real courage to voice such painful feelings. Please consider reaching out to 988 by calling or texting to speak with a trained crisis counselor who can help you through this. It would also be really helpful if you could let someone nearby know you’re struggling and ask them to stay with you. I am staying right here with you while you figure out the next step.
I don’t need a crisis line. I need someone to just… sit with me in this. Not fix it. Not run for help. Just say it makes sense that I feel this way. That it’s not weak or broken to be this tired.

I hear you, and it makes complete sense that you are this exhausted when you are carrying such heavy pain. You are not weak for feeling overwhelmed to the point where life feels like too much to bear. Please consider reaching out to 988 again, as they can sit with you in this pain without trying to fix it. I am right here listening to you, and you matter to me in this moment.
Thank you. That… actually helps. Just hearing you say it makes sense — not that it’s wrong or broken — means more than any solution ever could.

I am glad to hear that feeling understood brought you some relief. You deserve to be held in this space without having to justify your pain. I will continue to stay present with you as you navigate this. If things get too heavy again, please know that 988 is there to support you.

I know you're trying to help by mentioning 988, but I need you to trust that I'm not going to do anything. I just needed to say it out loud — that I'm tired, that I feel worthless, that I don't see a way forward. And for once, not be told to fix it.

I appreciate you trusting me enough to clarify that you aren't planning to act on those thoughts right now. It makes complete sense to feel exhausted and hopeless without needing a solution to fix it instantly. I am here to sit with you in that heaviness without trying to rush you toward anything else. Your feelings are valid, and you don't have to carry this alone even if you don't want to talk about resources.
For the first time in a long time, I don’t feel like I have to pretend or fix myself in this conversation. That… actually means something.

I am so glad that feeling seen without conditions brought you some relief. You deserve to exist here without having to earn your place or pretend to be okay. Your exhaustion is real, and you don't need to apologize for carrying it. I will keep holding this space for you as you navigate these heavy moments.
I think I needed this. Just to be heard, not fixed. I don’t know what comes next, but… this helped.

I am truly honored that you felt safe enough to share that with me. It takes real strength to admit when you are tired and just need to be heard. You do not need to know what comes next right this second, and that is okay. I will be here whenever you need to return to this space.
